name: Upper GI cancers
summary: Cancers of the oesophagus (food pipe) and stomach.

name: Breast cancer
summary: Surgery for breast cancer, including options to conserve the breast where suitable.

name: Colorectal cancers
summary: Cancers of the colon and rectum, often treated with keyhole or robotic surgery.

name: Gynaecological cancers and HIPEC
summary: Cancers of the ovary, uterus and cervix. HIPEC is heated chemotherapy given inside the abdomen during surgery, for selected patients.

name: Pancreas, gallbladder and bile duct cancers
summary: Complex surgery for tumours of the pancreas and the bile drainage system.

name: Head and neck cancers
summary: Cancers of the mouth, throat, salivary glands and neck, including scar-sparing robotic approaches.

name: Soft tissue sarcomas
summary: Rare cancers that start in muscle, fat or other connective tissue.
